The '''Nebula Elite''' was an exclusive [[Squadron/Legends|squadron]] of top-ranking [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]] serving the [[Nebula Front/Legends|Nebula Front's]] militant wing. The squadron fielded [[Z-95 Headhunter/Legends|Z-95 Headhunters]], the predecessor to the [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|X-wing]], and were painted white and marked with Nebula Front's blue logo on the wing panels. Made up of the best veteran fighter [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]] occasionally selected from the [[Nebula Front (squadron)|Nebula Front squadron]].<ref name="SWPM">{{PocketModel|set=Scum & Villainy|cardname=Nebula Elite Z-95 Headhunter|link=https://www.starwars-universe.com/collectionnables-serie-356-scum-R-villainy.html#carte}}</ref>
